nom: Charlotte Tilbury Charlotte's Magic Hydration Revival Cleanser

segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers are consistently positive, several specifically praising it for not leaving skin tight or stripped during colder months or after switching from a drying gel cleanser, and one reports it clearing dry patches on her face.
segments.combination: The small number of combination-skin reviewers say it balances their skin, with one reporting the dry areas of her face became more moisturized and the oilier areas felt more normal.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are sharply split: several, including ones with rosacea or seborrheic dermatitis, report no irritation and a gentle, calming feel, while others say the fragrance burned their skin, gave them a headache, or triggered migraines, and one review specifically cautions against it for extremely sensitive skin.

concerns.dehydration: An overwhelming majority describe the cleanser as genuinely non-drying and hydrating, with skin feeling soft and never tight after rinsing, including several who specifically sought it out for dry or dehydrated skin; a couple of dissenting reviewers feel the hydrating claim is overstated, and a few who reacted badly to the formula report their skin left tight and stripped by the burning sensation itself.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with no history of skin issues reports her face turned red and felt raw after the product burned her skin; by contrast, a reviewer with rosacea says the formula was gentle and caused no irritation.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including some who say they normally break out easily, report no new breakouts and even fewer blemishes than with their previous cleanser; the exception is a reviewer with no history of acne who broke out across her cheeks the day after her skin burned and turned red from the product, and another review cautions it may not suit extremely acne-prone skin.
concerns.oiliness: The few reviewers who mention oiliness say it leaves skin balanced rather than greasy, including one with combination skin whose oilier areas felt more normal after switching to it.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer credits the cleanser with reinforcing her skin barrier over continued use; no other reviewer comments on barrier support specifically.

aspects.libelle: Light, pleasant scent for most users
Burning or stinging reported by several
Doesn't fully remove makeup alone for some
Pricey relative to the amount you get

extraits.titre: I would not buy this product again
extraits.texte: I absolutely love all of Charlotte Tilbury face care products, except this cleanser. It is very harsh my skin started burning as soon as I started rubbing it in my cheeks. It almost felt like I had small cuts on my skin or something. I left it for about another minute to see if the burning subsided, but it only got worse. I will admit it deeply, deeply cleans your face and strips it of any oils as well which I didn't like. My face was left tight as a drum, red as a beet and the next day I broke out (mind you I never have acne) I had pimples all on my cheeks. All in all it was way too harsh for my skin.

This burned my skin around my cheeks where I have sensitivity. It has a heavy scent that gave me a headache. It is milky then foaming when you get it going. There are so many ingredients and too many in my opinion. It feels like makeup rather than skincare and clean.

It comes in a beautiful tube packaging that is easy to use. The texture is very silky to begin with and then emulsifies into foam and milky consistency. It is not stripping so it can work well for some folks. For me, the deal breaker was the strong fragrance. I get migraines and have sensitive skin and the fragrance in this was so strong that it triggered both so it is a no for me..

**I received this product for free, in exchange for an honest review.** It's almost as if the skincare gods knew exactly what I needed. My skin generally gets super dry during the colder months and I religiously wash my face and sometimes forget to moisturize (don't hate me). My usual cleanser that I get from my esthetician is great, but is a bit drying (it is a gel cleanser). The Magic Hydration Revival Cleanser definitely left my face NOT dry after cleansing my face with it. It's a decent-sized tube that should last quite a while - a little should go a long way. It's very soft and sulky as far as a "cream" cleanser goes. I will continue to use this as a secondary cleanser. The only thing that I don't love and would probably deduct 1/2 a star for is the scent. It's not a BAD scent - it's actually either unsent or very faintly scented - but something in the formula has a slightly medicinal smell and my sensitive nose doesn't love it. It's bearable to use, though. Overall, 4.5/5 stars. Great supplemental cleanser for any routine for someone with dry skin concerns.

This worked for me, I have seborrheic dermatitis and sensitive skin, this cleanser didn't break me out or agrivate my skin condition. It was very moisturizing and worked very well with the moisturizer, it does have a fragrance but it was nice and it didn't get overwhelming. I used it to remove makeup and it worked without stripping the skin. I'm still currently using it even though I ran out of the moisturizer, it worked out with other skin care products.

l received this product in exchange for my honest review. I really liked using this cleanser. I'm not a huge fan of the light scent but it wouldn't stop me from using it. I have combo skin and it made the dry bits moisturized and the greasy areas more normal. I felt the cleanser was gentle and made my skin better. I'd recommend for any skin type!

extraits.titre: Must have for dry, sensitive skin!
extraits.texte: I have sensitive, dry skin with rosacea, and this was truly gentle on my skin! I didn't notice any irritation and my skin felt so soft and clean. I paired it with the magic cream and I'm obsessed with how nice and plump my skin looks afterwards!
